name: Thief
source:
Hobbies: Stealing (especially people's hearts)
Weapon: Knife

"I want to steal your heart!"
The thief whose manner became flashy. 
"Your heart is the one thing I want to steal most, you know. 

[Edited from [url=http://otome-jikan.net/2013/02/rejets-dot-kareshi-were-8bit-lovers/]Ilinox[/url]]
